existing.description: The Wien International Scholarship Program, established at Brandeis University in 1958, brings undergraduate students from around the world to campus. It is awarded to exceptional international applicants who show strong academic achievement and extracurricular or community involvement, and it meets the full demonstrated financial need of each recipient based on a complete review of financial documentation. There is no separate application: candidates apply to Brandeis through the Common Application or Coalition Application and are considered automatically, with the award notice included in the admission decision. International applicants file the CSS Profile and any additional documentation by Nov. 2 (Early Decision I / Early Action) or Jan. 15 (Early Decision II / Regular Decision), and scholars renew annually with a March 1 renewal filing.
eligibility: International applicant to Brandeis University undergraduate program.
Must demonstrate financial need (CSS Profile required).
